address: 139/5 Wireless Road, Lumphini, Pathum Wan, Bangkok, 10330, Thailand
bio: At this sister restaurant to Le Du, comforting family recipes take centre stage. The intimate venue boasts a contemporary look with marble tables and chic lighting. They prioritise high-quality ingredients, including beef from Pak Chong's Islamic farms and responsibly sourced seafood from southern Thailand. Pair dishes with their selection of biodynamic, organic wines and house cocktails....
